aria-label.zh-CN: 滑块的可访问名称；`range` 模式下两个滑块在其后分别追加语言包中的起点、终点。
aria-label.en-US: Accessible name of the handle. In `range` mode, the locale's start and end texts are appended for the two handles.

aria-labelledby.zh-CN: 引用标签元素的 id，作为滑块的可访问名称；`range` 模式下每个滑块的名称为该标签加上起点或终点。
aria-labelledby.en-US: The id of the labelling element, used as the handle's accessible name. In `range` mode each handle's name is that label plus its start or end text.

aria-valuetext.zh-CN: 为当前值提供用户友好的名称；设置了 `getAriaValueText` 时以其结果为准。
aria-valuetext.en-US: A user-friendly name for the current value. `getAriaValueText` takes precedence when set.

defaultValue.zh-CN: 非受控时的初始取值，未设置时为 `min`。
defaultValue.en-US: Initial value when uncontrolled. Defaults to `min`.

getAriaValueText.zh-CN: 为滑块的当前值提供用户友好的名称，参数为该滑块的值与顺序，优先于 `aria-valuetext`。
getAriaValueText.en-US: Provides a user-friendly name for the current value, called with the handle's value and its index. Takes precedence over `aria-valuetext`.

handleDot.zh-CN: 滑块上的圆点，单个滑块传一个对象，`range` 模式下传与滑块一一对应的数组。
handleDot.en-US: Dot on the handle: one object for a single handle, an array with one per handle in `range` mode.

id.zh-CN: 落在第一个滑块的 input 上，`<label htmlFor>` 指向它时点击 label 会聚焦该滑块。
id.en-US: Set on the first handle's input, so a `<label htmlFor>` pointing at it focuses the slider when clicked.

included.zh-CN: `marks` 不为空对象时有效，值为 `true` 时表示值为包含关系，`false` 表示并列。
included.en-US: Takes effect when `marks` is not an empty object. `true` makes the values nested, `false` makes them independent.

marks.zh-CN: 刻度，key 的类型必须为 `number` 且取值在闭区间 [min, max] 内，值为任意节点，显示在刻度旁与刻度提示中。
marks.en-US: Marks. Keys must be `number` values in the closed range [min, max]; values are any node, shown next to the mark and in its tooltip.

name.zh-CN: 原生表单提交时的字段名，落在每个滑块的 input 上；`range` 模式下两个 input 同名，依次提交两个值。
name.en-US: Field name submitted with a native form, set on each handle's input. In `range` mode both inputs share it and submit two values in order.

onAfterChange.zh-CN: 值变化完成后触发，参数为当前取值；受控值被改回 `undefined` 时不触发。
onAfterChange.en-US: Fires after a change is complete, with the current value. Not fired when a controlled value goes back to `undefined`.

onChange.zh-CN: 值变化时触发，参数为当前取值。
onChange.en-US: Fires when the value changes, with the current value.

onFocus.zh-CN: 任一滑块获得焦点时触发，挂在 `.semi-slider-wrapper` 上。
onFocus.en-US: Fires when either handle gets focus, attached to `.semi-slider-wrapper`.

onMouseUp.zh-CN: 拖动滑块的指针（鼠标、触摸、触控笔）松开或被取消时，以及取值键松开时触发。
onMouseUp.en-US: Fires when the pointer (mouse, touch or pen) that dragged the handle is released or cancelled, and when a value key is released.

range.zh-CN: 是否支持两端同时可滑动。
range.en-US: Whether both ends can be dragged.

showArrow.en-US: Whether the tooltip has an arrow.

showBoundary.zh-CN: 是否在悬停时展示最大值与最小值。
showBoundary.en-US: Whether to show the maximum and minimum on hover.

showMarkLabel.en-US: Whether to show the mark labels.

tipFormatter.zh-CN: 设置提示的展示格式，每个滑块单独调用，参数为该滑块的值；传 `null` 隐藏提示。
tipFormatter.en-US: Format of the tooltip, called once per handle with that handle's value. Pass `null` to hide the tooltip.

tooltipOnMark.zh-CN: 滑轨上的刻度是否带有提示。
tooltipOnMark.en-US: Whether the marks on the rail have a tooltip.

tooltipVisible.en-US: Whether the tooltip is always visible.

value.zh-CN: 当前取值，受控使用；只传 `value` 而不在 `onChange` 中回写时，拖动、点击与方向键仅触发 `onChange`，滑块不移动。变回 `undefined` 时回到 `defaultValue`，没有则回到 `min`，且不触发 `onAfterChange`。
value.en-US: Current value, for controlled use. With `value` but no write-back in `onChange`, dragging, clicking and arrow keys only fire `onChange` and the handle does not move. Back to `undefined` it returns to `defaultValue`, or `min` without one, and `onAfterChange` does not fire.

verticalReverse.zh-CN: 反转垂直方向，即上大下小。
verticalReverse.en-US: Reverses the vertical direction, so the larger value is on top.

title.zh-CN: 落在 `.semi-slider-wrapper` 元素上的 title 属性。
title.en-US: The title attribute set on the `.semi-slider-wrapper` element.
